marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Job application looking good on paper

"Applying for a job can be an intimidating process; especially if it's your first job or if you have held the same position for a long time. How do you really know what they're looking for? Well, the key to getting the first step right is a clear and concise job application, because employers simply don't have the time to go through lengthy, unfocused submissions. This program will help you focus on expressing your skills and experience, writing applications that really stand out, and addressing the all-important selection criteria. It also examines online job applications. Chapters: 1. Identifying Your Skills 2. Looking for a Job 3. Writing a Good Cover Letter 4. Writing a Good Resume 5. Addressing the Selection Criteria" -- Publisher's web site.
